finding: All 144 currently-valid, non-PQC certs on this system are harvest-now-decrypt-later exposed starting today — any traffic they protect can be captured now and decrypted whenever a CRQC exists, independent of cert expiry. 98 of those certs remain in active service past the illustrative 2036 threshold used here, meaning they will keep generating NEW harvestable traffic for years into the window during which a CRQC is plausibly expected by at least some public estimates. This turns WD-089-001's static count into a time-bounded risk rather than a single snapshot.
